title: ILAU Orientation Instruments
subtitle: One source family · nineteen curated instruments · explicit claim ceiling

admission.scope: One read-only Navigator lens over nineteen owner-selected, already inventoried HTML instruments from the same documentary family
does_not_admit: the remaining OEIS LOGIK corpus as Navigator entities
a scientific theory, mechanism or empirical result

source_family.name: ILAU Field Lab and Neon n-Band Documentary Intake
authority_order: Report II — FROM GAP TO RETURN
Report III — KHIPPU AND THE THREADS

instruments.title: Hook · Mirror · Rope
instruments.role: Primary carrier, aperture and continued-trace instrument
instruments.summary: Inside and outside views meet at a central seam; two apertures flank a hook-like continued trace. The owner additionally reads the cavities and central cyan-violet flame as a strong visual orientation cue.
instruments.claim_boundary: Cavity and flame are visual readings of the drawing, not asserted physical objects or mechanisms; hook and aperture remain documentary operators until domains and maps are supplied.

instruments.title: Orientation Machine
instruments.summary: State → operator → cut → ILAU audit → residual → declared return.
instruments.claim_boundary: Cross-family orientation and contextual view; no new core, mechanism or scientific proof.

instruments.title: ILAU × Cartography
instruments.summary: Separates ILAU semantic classification from color, position, line, opacity, layer and other cartographic encodings.
instruments.claim_boundary: Cartography records a visible relation; it does not establish ontology.

instruments.title: OEIS Relation Machine
instruments.summary: Normalizes a raw sequence, queries bounded candidates, audits ILAU status and tests reconstruction.
instruments.claim_boundary: A sequence candidate is a mapped relation, not a cause, identity claim or ontology oracle.

instruments.title: Seam Reconstruction Gate
instruments.summary: Cuts one carrier into local sides, declares seam data, then tests stitch, transport and return against tolerance.
instruments.claim_boundary: A bounded seam joins declared local sides; it does not prove global identity.

instruments.title: KHIPPU · Cuts, Knots & Threads
instruments.summary: Places cut, seam, frame, retained, return and open-end roles on one common carrier.
instruments.claim_boundary: The knot binds a relation and preserves the cut; the glyph does not establish a physical thread mechanism.

instruments.title: Return / Residual
instruments.summary: Compares a declared reconstruction against a threshold while preserving the open residual.
instruments.claim_boundary: A bounded return is local to its declared carrier, map, correspondence and tolerance; local return is not global identity.

instruments.title: Hear the Shadow
instruments.role: Tone, beat, residual and octave-return view
instruments.summary: Relates pitch classes, superposition, beat envelope and octave equivalence as a return-oriented acoustic view.
instruments.claim_boundary: Standard acoustic relations support the example; the NEXAH shadow vocabulary remains a cartographic analogy.

instruments.title: The Record / Play Operator
instruments.summary: Uses one 432 state with four register cuts, normalized rings, overlap, shadow and return.
instruments.claim_boundary: Common numerical state and interval ratios do not make musical registers one physical operator.

instruments.title: Intertwined Clefs / B–8–ß Loop
instruments.summary: Separates spatial register from temporal sampling and binds the shared trace at a declared cut plane.
instruments.claim_boundary: Similarity of B, 8 and ß forms is not identity of registers, traces or operators.

instruments.title: 40 · 41 · 42 Relational Coordinate
instruments.summary: Centers three global values at 41 to expose local states −1, 0 and +1 and a total opening of 2.
instruments.claim_boundary: Changing origin reveals a relation but does not privilege 41 as a universal center.

instruments.title: Crown · Seam · Root
instruments.summary: Places crown and root as local fields on one carrier with a shared crossing, seam and relational binder.
instruments.claim_boundary: A shared outline or crossing does not imply identical dynamics.

instruments.title: Knot + Rope Around Body
instruments.summary: Tracks a closed route around an excluded carrier body and compares returned direction at the pin.
instruments.claim_boundary: Closed position return may retain a directional residual; route closure is not full-state identity.

instruments.title: State Space: Temperature · Pressure · Rotation
instruments.role: State, move, cut and representation view
instruments.summary: Models one state in temperature-pressure-rotation coordinates and projects a transformed state through a declared measurement cut.
instruments.claim_boundary: The diagram is a representation grammar, not an empirical thermodynamic model or measured trajectory.

instruments.title: DEL–T–RIS · The Return Seam
instruments.role: Cut, return, residual and decision view
instruments.summary: Shows a declared return path, seam, measured residual and thresholded closed/open decision.
instruments.claim_boundary: The displayed numerical threshold is illustrative and does not define a universal acceptance rule.

instruments.title: α · Residual Code
instruments.summary: Projects a moved state, compares residual curve with an envelope and records a signed normalized code.
instruments.claim_boundary: The alpha code summarizes one declared residual and envelope; it is not an intrinsic object property.

instruments.title: Neon: Cartography ≠ Ontology
instruments.summary: Keeps a fixed field separate from low, bounded and excessive visibility renderings.
instruments.claim_boundary: Neon is a map, not the represented object; improved visibility does not establish ontology.

instruments.title: BPS–MS · Cover, Cut, Kernel & Gap
instruments.summary: Maps overlapping phase-state covers, a common kernel, a representation cut and the remaining gap.
instruments.claim_boundary: The phase labels and cover geometry are documentary modeling choices, not validated material-state dynamics.

instruments.title: From Gap to Return
instruments.summary: Connects cover, kernel and gap to move, cut, representation, residual, closure and return while separating ontology from cartography.
instruments.claim_boundary: This is a synthesis of known math, NEXAH vocabulary and visual metaphor; physical claims require separate tests.

ilau.label: Retained
ilau.definition: Content retained under the declared comparison or tested return.

ilau.label: Lost
ilau.definition: Content excluded or no longer reconstructible after the declared frame, cut or map.

ilau.label: Added
ilau.definition: Content introduced by the representation, model, threshold, key or encoding.

ilau.label: Unresolved
ilau.definition: Alternatives or residual structure not decidable from the available record.

claim_ceiling: Internal documentary orientation only. ILAU classification != causal explanation != decision rule. ILAU remains a local comparison vocabulary. Cartographic similarity does not establish ontology, shared mechanism, physical identity, empirical validation or public admission.
